title: TRUCK BUNGEE DESTRUCTION
prompt: Create an original finished TRANSPARENT title logo for a 1998–2002 PS1/PS2 mascot arcade sports game. Required reference style: CHUNKY WOBBLY UNEVEN custom hand-lettering, strong sculpted angular bevels painted in THREE broad color planes, thick blue-black outline plus ivory keyline, low-poly faceted toy semi trucks with enormous wheels. Invent a distinct composition. NO realistic materials, no photographic detail, no shiny modern mobile logo, no fine noise. Crisp HD illustration, not pixel art. No panel/background scene, genuine alpha, ample clear margins. All exact words legible and unobscured. EXACT title: "TRUCK BUNGEE DESTRUCTION". Composition: Purple and acid orange STRETCHED hand-lettered words tethered by a thick curving bungee cable, tiny faceted blue semi swinging diagonally at LEFT into a simple fractured brick tower at right. A few huge cartoon masonry chunks, no realistic rubble.
